facts.text: The beachfront resort is in Marina Vallarta, minutes from downtown Puerto Vallarta and the airport.
facts.excerpt: Located in Marina Vallarta, minutes from downtown and the airport, this beachfront retreat blends recreation, culture, and restorative serenity.

facts.text: The resort has two outdoor pools overlooking the Pacific.
facts.excerpt: unwind by one of two outdoor pools overlooking the Pacific

facts.text: Suites include swim-up and private plunge pool options.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Playa Vallarta features 281 redesigned suites, including swim-up accommodations and private plunge pool options

facts.text: The Heavenly Pool Panoramic Suite is on the top floors, with ocean views from a private balcony and a plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Set on the resort's top floors, the 581 sqft / 52 sqm Heavenly Pool Panoramic Suite offers stunning ocean views from your private balcony.

facts.text: The swim-up suite is an adult-only retreat that opens onto a swim-up pool.
facts.excerpt: Step from your suite into a serene swim-up pool in this adult-only retreat.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is a top-floor retreat with a private balcony, bay and ocean views and a plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Discover an expansive top-floor retreat with a sweeping private balcony offering endless bay and ocean views, alfresco dining, and a plunge pool

facts.text: The Heavenly Penthouse is a bi-level suite with a plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay in our 732 sqft / 66 sqm Heavenly Penthouse, a bi-level suite with a plunge pool.

facts.text: Private balconies look over Banderas Bay or the hotel grounds.
facts.excerpt: Your private balcony offers views of Banderas Bay and/or our beautiful hotel grounds

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa offers hydrotherapy with plunge pools, showers and warm water massage jets.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the benefits of our hydrotherapy sessions heating up, cooling down at our plunge pools or showers or simply relaxing at the warm water and massage jets

facts.text: The resort has tennis, pickleball and padel courts.
facts.excerpt: Stay active with our WestinWORKOUT® fitness studio, tennis, pickleball, and padel courts.

facts.text: The resort uses biophilic design with lush landscapes, open-air spaces and natural light.
facts.excerpt: our resort embraces biophilic design, seamlessly integrating lush landscapes, open-air spaces, and natural light

facts.text: Guests can join oceanfront yoga or a ceviche-making session.
facts.excerpt: Start your day with oceanfront yoga or join a ceviche-making session with local flair.

facts.text: Agave Studio in the Gourmet Gallery offers mezcal tastings.
facts.excerpt: New to the Gourmet Gallery is the Agave Studio, where guests can indulge in tastings to learn about the rich heritage of mezcal.

facts.text: Dining spans six restaurants in the Gourmet Gallery plus four open-air restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: Gourmet Gallery dining, featuring...See More six distinct restaurants, as well as our four open-air restaurants and bars

facts.text: The resort is family-friendly and open to guests of all ages.
facts.excerpt: is a Family-Friendly resort and is open to guests of all ages
